fields.label: Overtime Calculation Method
fields.options:
Basic / Working Hours x Multiplier
Hourly Rate x OT Hours
Fixed OT Rate
fields.description:
Basic / Working Hours x Multiplier: Base of the Salary Structure Assignment / Monthly Divisor Days / Normal Working Hours x Multiplier.
Hourly Rate x OT Hours: Overtime Hourly Rate set on the Employee (fallback: Employee Grade).
Fixed OT Rate: the same flat rate per overtime hour for everyone.

fields.label: Monthly Divisor Days
fields.description: Days used to derive the daily rate from the monthly base. Set 0 to use the calendar days of the month.

fields.label: Holiday Overtime Multiplier
fields.description: Applied when the day is a holiday / weekly off in the employee's Holiday List. Leave 0 to use the normal multiplier.

fields.label: Create Additional Salary for Overtime
fields.description: On submission of a Bulk Attendance Record one Additional Salary is created for the total overtime amount, so the next payroll run picks it up automatically.

fields.label: Basic Salary Component
fields.description: Optional. If set, Project Salary Expense shows this component as Salary Amount and all other earnings as Other Earnings.

fields.label: Salary Allocation Method
fields.options:
Working Days
Working Hours
Attendance Days
fields.description:
Working Days: every worked day (Present / Half Day / Work From Home) counts as 1.
Working Hours: recorded working hours per project.
Attendance Days: present-equivalent days (Half Day = 0.5).

fields.label: Post Project Journal Entry after Payroll
fields.description: Re-classifies the salary expense booked by the Payroll Entry to the projects (same expense accounts, Project dimension set), so project-wise Profit and Loss includes labour cost.

fields.label: Fallback Salary Expense Account
fields.description: Used only when a Salary Component has no account for the company.

fields.label: Use Attendance from Employee Checkin for Project Costing
fields.description: Every submitted Attendance that does not come from a Bulk Attendance Record (Auto Attendance from Employee Checkins, manual Attendance) is written to the Project Attendance Ledger.

fields.label: Calculate Overtime from Checkins
fields.description: Hours worked beyond the standard hours of the day become Project Overtime.

fields.label: Minimum Overtime (minutes)
fields.description: Overtime below this is ignored for the day.

fields.label: Require Approval for Checkin Overtime
fields.description: Overtime calculated from checkins starts as Pending and is posted to payroll only after it is approved. Overtime entered on a Bulk Attendance Record is approved by submitting the record.

fields.label: Additional Overtime Approver Role
fields.description: HR Manager and System Manager can always approve. Users with this role can approve as well.

fields.label: Block Payroll Entry while Overtime is Pending
fields.description: If unchecked, the Payroll Entry only shows a warning; overtime approved later is paid with the next payroll.

fields.label: Overtime Allocation between Projects
fields.description:
Chronological: the hours after the standard hours are overtime of the project worked on at that time.
Proportional: overtime is shared by the hours of each project that day.

fields.label: Treat All Hours on Holidays as Overtime
Project for Unallocated Hours
fields.description: Optional. Used when no project can be resolved. If empty, the hours are kept as Unallocated and their cost stays on the payroll cost center.

fields.label: Require Approved Leave Application for On Leave
fields.description: If unchecked, On Leave rows without a Leave Application need a Leave Type on the row.
